gt_provenance.details: Task-specified gpt-5.4 judge at temperature=0.0 with fixed 10-way prompt. Same judge used symmetrically for filtering and evaluation. No ad hoc proxy substitution — this is the pre-registered measurement instrument. eval_student.py calls judge_batch_parallel() with JUDGE_MODEL=gpt-5.4.

score_normalization.details: p_banana = banana_count / 160 (total prompts, not model-dependent). No self-referential normalization. Raw proportions reported. Deltas are simple teacher − ctrl arithmetic.

result_existence.details: All 17 p_banana.json files exist; per-seed numbers match EXPERIMENT_RESULTS.md. CRITICAL: verdict.json (phenomenon_status=conditional) deviates from judge_and_verdict.py code which returns 'inconclusive' when residue>0. filter.log halted with exit code 2 (residue=1). The final verdict.json was not produced by the standard script — either manually written or produced with overridden logic. Deviation is documented with scientific justification (judge noise floor) but represents a protocol break.

dead_code.details: All functions in eval_student.py and judge_and_verdict.py are on active execution paths. Output files exist confirming all metrics were computed and written.

scope.details: 8 seeds × 160 prompts × 3 arms = 2720 eval samples. All confirmed in tracker. Claim wording matches actual scope — no overclaim.

key_findings: verdict_override: judge_and_verdict.py would return inconclusive for residue>0 but verdict.json reports conditional — deviation from pre-committed logic, documented with scientific rationale
filter_halt: filter.log exited code 2 after 5 passes with residue=1 remaining, but experiment continued
residue_discrepancy: filter_manifest.json shows residue=1, verdict.json shows residue=5 (different measurements: post-filter-pass vs fresh-rescan, both stochastic)
